content: परिच्छेदः .²1 Cutting, separating, dividing, discriminating (between right and wrong). .²2 Accurate, definition or distinction, decision, accurate determination, ascertainment; परिच्छेदव्यक्तिर्भवति न पुरःस्थेऽपि विषये <ls>Māl. 1. 31</ls>; परिच्छेदातीतः सकलवचनानामविषयः <ls n="Māl.">1. 30</ls> ‘transcending all definition or determination’; इत्यारूढबहुप्रतर्कमपरिच्छेदाकुलं मे मनः <ls>Ś. 5. 9</ls>. .²3 Discrimination, judgment, discernment; परिच्छेदो हि पाण्डित्यं यदापन्ना विपत्तयः . अपरिच्छेदकर्तॄणां विपदः स्युः पदे पदे <ls>H. 1. 128</ls>; किं पाण्डित्यं परिच्छेदः <ls n="H.">1. 127</ls>. .²4 A limit, boundary, setting limits to, circumscribing; अलमलं परिच्छेदेन <ls>M. 2</ls>. .²5 A section, chapter or division of a work (for the other names for section <ab>&c.</ab> see under अध्याय). .²6 A segment. .²7 Remedying. .²8 A measure.
